saving_clause.exception_paragraph: Article 20 benefits preserved for visiting students.

articles.note: Japan treaty (2004 protocol) exempts foreign-source maintenance/education only.

notes: AUDIT 2025-05-19: Verified Article 20 (Students and Business Apprentices) against IRS Pub 901 Table 2/3 (Japan) and US-Japan Income Tax Convention (2003; entered into force 2004-03-30, replacing the 1971 convention). Japan provides ONLY foreign-source maintenance/education exemption — no US-source student wage cap. The 2004 treaty has no Article 19 (teachers) carve-out that some older guides reference; visiting researchers must rely on §117 qualified-scholarship exclusion plus default NRA rules.
